record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare the ability WONDER_GUARD: Nincada (1 star, maxPP 110) and Shedinja (2 stars, maxPP 100). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (table index), maxPP and passive. Ninjask is not listed. The identifier WONDER_GUARD is also the name of a PASSIVE (Shedinja only, blocks 20 damage per hit); that passive is a separate mechanic and is not described here beyond a pointer.
record.summary: For every enemy standing in one of the up to 8 cells around the caster: first a 3000 ms paralysis request, then SPECIAL damage (raw 30/60/120/240 by the caster's stars; 30 for Nincada, 60 for Shedinja). The cast target is not used for geometry or damage (it is only passed to the base process for the animation). Paralysis is a request that Rune Protect or IMMUNITY_PARALYSIS cancels entirely, and the damage can be blocked separately by protect / skydiving / magicBounce. The ability of the same name as Shedinja's passive (-20 damage per hit received) is a different mechanic.

targeting.who: every enemy-team unit in the 8 cells adjacent to the caster at cast time
targeting.note: requiresTarget is true (the default), so the caster must have a target in range before the cast fires; the cast target itself is only used for the animation. Allies, empty cells and cells off the board are skipped.

geometry.shape: 3x3 square around the caster minus the centre (up to 8 cells), clipped by the board bounds

effects.target: each adjacent enemy (applied after that enemy's paralysis request, in cell scan order)
effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1] (fallback 240). handleSpecialDamage: x (1 + AP/100) because apBoost defaults to true; x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite on the target) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so it needs ABILITY_CRIT); the same crit flag applies to every adjacent target of the cast.
effects.resolution: applied = the figure handed to PokemonState.handleDamage. handleDamage then divides SPECIAL damage by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), applies flat reductions for targets with GUTS/STURDY/DEFIANT/COACHING effects or a Shedinja target's Wonder Guard passive, rounds up with a minimum of 1, and the target's shield absorbs first. takenDamage reported (not used by this strategy) = shield damage + HP damage capped at current hp; it is 0 if the target has protect / skydiving / magicBounce (blocked entirely, magicBounce may reflect after 500 ms).

statusEffects.scaling: apBoost defaults to false in triggerParalysis, so AP does not lengthen it. STORM weather multiplies the duration by 1.3 (each Electric Quartz in the target player's items then multiplies by 1 - 0.2), applyStatusDurationReductions may shorten it, the result is Math.round-ed and only replaces the remaining paralysisCooldown if it is longer (an existing longer paralysis is not shortened or refreshed).
statusEffects.guards: the entire request is ignored when the target has Rune Protect (status.runeProtect) or the IMMUNITY_PARALYSIS effect; a Cheri Berry holder eats it after a successful request. Protect / magicBounce on the target do not stop the paralysis request, only the damage (the request runs before the damage in the loop).

starBehavior.note: The table has four entries; the 3-star (120) and 4-star (240, also the ?? fallback) columns are not reachable by the bare factory star counts of the two listed units. Paralysis duration does not depend on stars.

record.positionalConditions: The caster's own cell and the board bounds decide which of the 8 neighbours exist; only occupied cells holding an enemy count. No facing or line logic.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP (floor 0) and repeats the same sweep; paralysis from repeated casts only extends the remaining time when the new duration is longer.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage 30 (Nincada) / 60 (Shedinja) SPECIAL per adjacent enemy and 3000 ms paralysis. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit, then reduced by the target's SPE_DEF and the flat reductions listed above, with a minimum of 1 per target; takenDamage includes shield damage. Applied paralysis = 3000 ms after weather and duration-reduction adjustments, ignored under Rune Protect / IMMUNITY_PARALYSIS, and only replacing a shorter remaining duration. Final values additionally depend on untraced item and field effects.
